mapper.select: select jt.*, e2.name as approver_name, d.name as target_dept_name from job_transfer jt left join emp e2 on jt.approver_id = e2.id left join dept d on jt.target_dept_id = d.id where jt.emp_id = #{empId} order by jt.create_time desc, jt.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into job_transfer (emp_id, current_job, target_job, target_dept_id, reason, status) values (#{empId}, #{currentJob}, #{targetJob}, #{targetDeptId}, #{reason}, 0)
